title: SessionResponse
description:
`GET /v1/session`, and the answer to a demo sign-in: what the cookie says, read without an
object call.

account.description: The account id, 64 hex characters; `null` for a guest.

expires_at.description: When the cookie stops being accepted, a wall time such as `2026-11-05T12:00:00.000Z`.

sandbox.description: The current sandbox's ULID, if any.

SessionKind.description: How a session signed in. A guest has no account.
